Shell setup

This article explains how to set up a shell environment and inspect the result. Read the commands in order and check the output before continuing. The first example lists the files in the working directory.

echo ARTICLE_CODE
ls -la

Note: install the tool before running the next example.

brew install ASIDE_CODE
brew doctor

After the setup command completes, run the check and inspect the result. Continue with the remaining article steps only when the tool is ready. See the setup guide for the complete example.
